sources.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is the supplied five-column two-row gray fox idle sprite sheet. Remove ONLY the unwanted blurred brown/gray background, haze and cast shadows surrounding the ten character figures. Replace with genuine fully transparent alpha. Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent 8-phase pixel-art walking sprite sheet. Input image 1 is this character's approved directional identity/idle study, not a target to copy as static poses. Generate the SAME character walking in ONE direction in EVERY frame: NORTH: looking straight away from the camera toward the top of the sheet; full back view, no visible face, both feet and shoes visible in rear perspective. Character: the upright red-orange dragon client with amber eyes, swept-back head spines, a red patterned tail, navy jacket, ivory shirt, red tie, charcoal trousers and black shoes. No wings or accessories. Preserve identity, outfit, proportions, tail, palette, crisp pixel-art style and restrained lighting. Exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight complete full-body figures in equal cells, read left-to-right across top row then bottom row. Animate a moderate natural WALK, not a run or shuffle. Pose order: (1) anatomical LEFT foot forward contact, RIGHT trails, right arm forward; (2) LEFT supports weight with slight knee bend and torso down, RIGHT heel lifts behind; (3) RIGHT foot passes beneath hips while LEFT supports, arms passing; (4) RIGHT knee swings forward preparing contact, LEFT heel begins lifting; (5) RIGHT forward contact, LEFT trails, left arm forward, the true opposite of frame 1; (6) RIGHT bears weight, LEFT heel lifts; (7) LEFT passes beneath hips, RIGHT supports; (8) LEFT knee forward before the next left contact. Make contact/loading/passing/knee-up visibly different and alternate the feet. Only contact frames have the widest stride; passing feet must come under the body. Arms counter-swing with legs, head steady, body subtle vertical weight, tail gentle continuous motion. SAME camera direction and same body scale, hip center, ground baseline and lighting throughout all eight cells. Full ear/head/tail/shoe silhouettes, generous transparent margins, no cell overlap. Do not repeat a single pose or show multiple viewing directions. Genuinely transparent background, no ground, cast shadows, checkerboard, labels, numbers, grid lines, scenery, matte, halo, props or extra characters.
